index.intro: How old am I today? Type your date of birth and this age calculator gives your exact age in years, months and days, with the date of your next birthday.
index.howto: How to use the age calculator

past.intro: How old was I on that day? Add your date of birth and any past date, such as an exam, a wedding or a date a form asks about, to see your age then.
past.howto: How to find your age on a past date

label.on: The date to look back to

difference.intro: Put in two dates of birth and the age difference calculator tells you who is older and by how much, down to the day.
difference.howto: How to use the age difference calculator

days-between-dates.intro: Count the days between dates, say from today to a deadline, and see how many of them are weekdays and how many fall at the weekend.
days-between-dates.howto: How to count the days between dates

chronological-age.intro: For test forms and reports, the chronological age calculator gives a child’s age on the test date as years;months;days, such as 8;4;12, ready to copy or print.
chronological-age.howto: How to use the chronological age calculator

dog-age.intro: Enter your dog’s age and adult size, and the dog age calculator reads their age in human years from the AAHA-published chart, not the old times-seven rule.
dog-age.howto: How to use the dog age calculator

cat-age.intro: Turn your cat’s age into human years with this cat age calculator. It reads the figure from the AAHA-published chart and tells you which life stage your cat has reached.
cat-age.howto: How to use the cat age calculator

korean-age.intro: The Korean age calculator puts international age, Korean age and year age side by side for one date of birth, so you can see why a Korean age runs one or two years higher.
korean-age.howto: How to use the Korean age calculator

birthday-countdown.intro: Our birthday countdown tells you how many days are left until the next birthday and what day of the week it falls on, with a clock ticking down to midnight tonight.
birthday-countdown.howto: How to use the birthday countdown

how-old-will-i-be.intro: How old will I be in 2050, or in any other year? Put in your date of birth and a year to see the age you reach and the day you reach it.
how-old-will-i-be.howto: How to work out a future age

what-year-was-i-born.intro: What year was I born, if I’m 31? Type your age and whether you’ve had your birthday yet this year, and you’ll get the year, or both years if you’re not sure.
what-year-was-i-born.howto: How to find your birth year

ui.parts_toggle_aria: Type the day, month and year in separate boxes
